hits.title: CollectivIQ launches AI workers for workplace roles
hits.snippet: # CollectivIQ launches AI workers for workplace roles Wed, 12th Aug 2026 (Yesterday) [SEAN MITCHELL Publisher](https://cfotech.news/author/sean-mitchell) CollectivIQ has launched Digital Direct Reports, an AI feature that assigns software agents to defined workplace roles. The product is available within the company's platform. The Boston-based company said the feature is intended to let organisations deploy AI workers for roles such as project management, executive support, software engineering, recruitment and data work. Unlike general AI assistants, each agent is assigned a specific function and can operate across the business software employees already use. Each Digital Direct Report is given a first and last name and configured with tools, permissions and knowledge tied to a particular role. These AI workers can retain context over time, collaborate with one another and carry out tasks within existing workflows, rather than only responding to prompts in a chat window. The launch reflects a broader shift in corporate AI use, from question-and-answer tools to software that can manage recurring work.
